==Polish==

===Etymology===
{{ety|pl|:inh|zlw-opl:chcieć|tree=+|text=+}}

===Pronunciation===
{{pl-pr|a=Pl-#.ogg;LL-Q809 (pol)-Olaf-#.wav|mp=#|las=#|MB=#|ost=#|pod=#|MD=#|krk=#|ekr=#}}

===Verb===
{{pl-verb|impf}}

# {{lb|pl|transitive}} to [[want]] {{gl|to wish for or desire}} {{+obj|pl|acc/gen<something> + inf<to do something>}}
#: {{uxi|pl|'''Chciałbym''' zjeść spaghetti.|I '''would like''' to eat spaghetti.}}
## {{lb|pl|transitive|Ostróda|Near Masovian|Łukowiec|Western Kraków|Lasovia|Bilcza}} to [[want]] {{gl|to wish to take as a spouse}}
## {{lb|pl|intransitive|Eastern Kraków|Skalbmierz|of a mare}} to [[want]] {{gl|to be in heat}} {{+obj|pl|:do(gen)<for what stallion>}}
# {{lb|pl|transitive}} {{ng|used in polite commands}}; to [[want]] {{+obj|pl|:żeby/:aby/:by(past-cl)<to do what>}}
#: {{uxi|pl|'''Chcę''', żebyś zjadł spaghetti.|I '''want''' you to eat spaghetti.}}
# {{lb|pl|transitive|of objects|usually negated}} to [[be able to]], [[can]]
# {{lb|pl|transitive|Far Masovian|Przasnysz|Western Kraków}} {{syn of|pl|mieć|t=[[going to]]; [[supposed to]]}}  {{+obj|pl|inf<to do something>}}
#: {{uxa|pl|Jak me zarzno, to ty '''chcij''' ze mnie flaki cyścić.|If they slaughter me, then you're '''going to''' clean out my guts.|qq=Far Masovian, Przasnysz}}
#: {{uxa|pl|Woda całe miasto '''chciała''' zalać.|Water was '''going to''' flood the whole city,|qq=Western Kraków}}
# {{lb|pl|reflexive-się|impersonal}} to [[feel like]], to [[want]] {{gl|to have a desire for something, or to do something}} {{+obj|pl|inf}}
#: {{uxi|pl|'''Chce''' mi '''się''' pobiegać.|I '''feel like''' running for a bit.}}
# {{lb|pl|reflexive-się|impersonal}} {{ng|used to indicate when someone is experiencing a specific condition of their body that is associated with an action indicated by the subordinate verb}}; to [[want]] {{+obj|pl|inf}}
#: {{uxi|pl|Nikomu nie '''chciało się''' spać.|No one '''was''' tired.|lit=No one '''felt like''' sleeping.}}
#: {{uxi|pl|'''Chce''' mi '''się''' jeść.|I''''m''' hungry.|lit=I '''feel like''' eating.}}
#: {{uxi|pl|'''Chce''' mi '''się''' pić.|I''''m''' thirsty.|lit=I '''feel like''' drinking.}}

====Usage notes====
The use of accusative or genitive is somewhat conditioned; accusative may be used when referring to concrete nouns in their entirety, e.g. {{m|pl||chcieć bułkę|to want a (whole) bun}}, and genitive may be used either for abstract nouns or as a {{lg|partitive}}, e.g. {{m|pl||chcieć pomocy|to want help}} or partitive {{m|pl||chcieć bułki|to want (some of a) bun}}.<ref>{{R:pl:PWN Poradnia|dr hab. Adam Wolański|6.04.2024|https://sjp.pwn.pl/poradnia/haslo/schemat-skladniowy-czasownika-chciec;23454.html}}</ref>
